$comment: High/critical npm audit advisories accepted for now. scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs fails CI on any advisory not listed here and on any entry past reviewBy. Each entry says why the risk is acceptable; delete it when the fix lands.

advisories.title: MCP TypeScript SDK: Experimental tasks were not tied to the session that created them
advisories.reason: Transitive via the creem billing SDK, which bundles an MCP server Needt never starts; Needt's own MCP server does not use this package. Clears when creem ships a newer SDK.

advisories.title: MCP TypeScript SDK: One HTTP request within the default size limit could exhaust server memory during validation
advisories.reason: Transitive via the creem billing SDK, which bundles an MCP server Needt never starts; Needt's own MCP server does not use this package. Clears when creem ships a newer SDK.

advisories.title: MCP TypeScript SDK: OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server
advisories.reason: Transitive via the creem billing SDK, which bundles an MCP server Needt never starts; Needt's own MCP server does not use this package. Clears when creem ships a newer SDK.

advisories.title: Sentry-Javascript: Middleware Bypass when using Tunnel route
advisories.reason: Affects only the Sentry tunnel route, which next.config.js does not configure (no tunnelRoute). Bump to >=10.75.2 after launch.

advisories.title: Tiptap: Quadratic ReDoS in block and inline Markdown attribute parsing
advisories.reason: Markdown attribute ReDoS; the fix is in @tiptap 3.30.5, a minor upgrade of 13 editor packages from 3.28 with no 3.28.x patch. Scheduled after launch.

advisories.title: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion in parseCommaParts causing stack exhaustion
advisories.reason: Build-time only: glob/minimatch inside the Sentry bundler plugin and tailwindcss; never sees user input at runtime.

advisories.title: brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups causing stack exhaustion
advisories.reason: Build-time only: glob/minimatch inside the Sentry bundler plugin and tailwindcss; never sees user input at runtime.

advisories.title: fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via skipped IDN canonicalization on scheme-relative references
advisories.reason: Transitive via ajv inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); Needt does not use it to parse or fetch URLs. SSRF defence is src/services/oauth/safe-fetch.ts.

advisories.title: fast-uri vulnerable to server-side request forgery via malformed IPv6 normalization
advisories.reason: Transitive via ajv inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); Needt does not use it to parse or fetch URLs. SSRF defence is src/services/oauth/safe-fetch.ts.

advisories.title: fast-uri vulnerable to server-side request forgery via repeated hostname percent-decoding
advisories.reason: Transitive via ajv inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); Needt does not use it to parse or fetch URLs. SSRF defence is src/services/oauth/safe-fetch.ts.

advisories.title: fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via percent-encoded scheme normalization
advisories.reason: Transitive via ajv inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); Needt does not use it to parse or fetch URLs. SSRF defence is src/services/oauth/safe-fetch.ts.

advisories.title: fast-uri vulnerable to authority injection via an unvalidated port in serialize
advisories.reason: Transitive via ajv inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); Needt does not use it to parse or fetch URLs. SSRF defence is src/services/oauth/safe-fetch.ts.

advisories.title: lodash vulnerable to Code Injection via `_.template` imports key names
advisories.reason: Client bundle via mermaid (Excalidraw); Needt never calls _.template, the affected function.

advisories.title: nanoid: non-secure generators can loop indefinitely with negative size
advisories.reason: Client bundle via Excalidraw and mermaid; ids there are not security tokens and sizes are constants. Fix needs an Excalidraw major.

advisories.title: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
advisories.reason: Client bundle via Excalidraw and mermaid; ids there are not security tokens and sizes are constants. Fix needs an Excalidraw major.

advisories.title: nanoid: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
advisories.reason: Client bundle via Excalidraw and mermaid; ids there are not security tokens and sizes are constants. Fix needs an Excalidraw major.

advisories.title: Nodemailer: Quadratic (O(n²)) time complexity in addressparser allows remote denial of service via a crafted address list
advisories.reason: Pulled by @auth/core and next-auth for their email sign-in provider, which Needt does not configure; no code in src imports nodemailer. Fix needs nodemailer 10.x outside next-auth's range.

advisories.title: Nodemailer: Quadratic backtracking in the addressparser free-text fallback allows remote denial of service
advisories.reason: Pulled by @auth/core and next-auth for their email sign-in provider, which Needt does not configure; no code in src imports nodemailer. Fix needs nodemailer 10.x outside next-auth's range.

advisories.title: PostCSS: Arbitrary file read and information disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS comments
advisories.reason: Build-time only (tailwindcss and Next's bundled postcss) over CSS from this repository; no user CSS is processed.

advisories.title: PostCSS: Path Traversal in Previous Source Map Auto-Loading (sourceMappingURL) leads to Arbitrary .map File Disclosure
advisories.reason: Build-time only (tailwindcss and Next's bundled postcss) over CSS from this repository; no user CSS is processed.

advisories.title: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet
advisories.reason: Transitive via express inside @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (creem); no express server runs in Needt, so no trust-proxy decision uses it.

advisories.title: sharp inherited vulnerabilities in libvips: CVE-2026-33327, CVE-2026-33328, CVE-2026-35590, CVE-2026-35591
advisories.reason: Optional dependency of next; next 15.5.28 disables AVIF optimisation with sharp 0.34 and next.config.js configures no remote images. Bump to 0.35.5 after launch.

advisories.title: sharp: Vulnerabilities in libheif: GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 and GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545
advisories.reason: Optional dependency of next; next 15.5.28 disables AVIF optimisation with sharp 0.34 and next.config.js configures no remote images. Bump to 0.35.5 after launch.

advisories.title: sharp : Vulnerability in librsvg dependency CVE-2026-96889
advisories.reason: Optional dependency of next; next 15.5.28 disables AVIF optimisation with sharp 0.34 and next.config.js configures no remote images. Bump to 0.35.5 after launch.

advisories.title: source-map-js allows event-loop denial of service through indexed source-map section offsets
advisories.reason: Build-time only via sass (Excalidraw) and postcss; parses source maps from this repository.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reason: Root zod is 3.x (fix only in zod 4, a major migration); the 4.x copies are inside creem and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. Request bodies reach zod after the route's own size limits.
